request.subject: PORTRAIT:KNIGHT

layers.text: Redraw him as a high-medieval knight: a gold-yellow crown band around the steel great helm and a deep crimson plume; a deep crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow lion over steel mail and a crimson cape with a gold trim; a small crimson and gold pennant below the lance point. Keep the lance, the helm, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
